paper_metadata.title: Qwen3-VL Technical Report
paper_metadata.abstract: We introduce Qwen3-VL, the most capable vision-language model in the Qwen series to date, achieving superior performance across a broad range of multimodal benchmarks. It natively supports interleaved contexts of up to 256K tokens, seamlessly integrating text, images, and video. The model family includes both dense (2B/4B/8B/32B) and mixture-of-experts (30B-A3B/235B-A22B) variants to accommodate diverse latency-quality trade-offs. Qwen3-VL delivers three core pillars: (i) markedly stronger pure-text understanding, surpassing comparable text-only backbones in several cases; (ii) robust long-context comprehension with a native 256K-token window for both text and interleaved multimodal inputs, enabling faithful retention, retrieval, and cross-referencing across long documents and videos; and (iii) advanced multimodal reasoning across single-image, multi-image, and video tasks, demonstrating leading performance on comprehensive evaluations such as MMMU and visual-math benchmarks (e.g., MathVista and MathVision). Architecturally, we introduce three key upgrades: (i) an enhanced interleaved-MRoPE for stronger spatial-temporal modeling across images and video; (ii) DeepStack integration, which effectively leverages multi-level ViT features to tighten vision-language alignment; and (iii) text-based time alignment for video, evolving from T-RoPE to explicit textual timestamp alignment for more precise temporal grounding. Under comparable token budgets and latency constraints, Qwen3-VL achieves superior performance in both dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures. We envision Qwen3-VL serving as a foundational engine for image-grounded reasoning, agentic decision-making, and multimodal code intelligence in real-world workflows.

classification.reason: LLM classification: IN_DOMAIN (domain: VLM version release)

extraction_data.innovation: DeepStack mechanism: injects visual tokens from multiple layers of the vision encoder into corresponding layers of the LLM to preserve rich visual information; Interleaved MRoPE: redesigns frequency allocation by interleaving temporal, horizontal, and vertical components across embedding dimensions to ensure uniform representation and mitigate spectral bias; text-based timestamp tokens: prefixes each video temporal patch with a formatted text string to effectively capture temporal structure.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: Image-caption pairs, interleaved text-image documents, video, agent-oriented instruction-following data, text-only data
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Supervised fine-tuning, knowledge distillation, reinforcement learning, Instruct tuning, Thinking/Non-thinking hybrid reasoning tuning, Instruction tuning, reasoning tuning, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Strong-to-Weak Distillation, Reinforcement Learning (Reasoning RL and General RL)
extraction_data.hardware_used: Alibaba Cloud's PAI-Lingjun AI Computing Service
extraction_data.research_problem: Multimodal reasoning, visual question answering, document understanding, instruction following
extraction_data.application: Image-grounded reasoning, agentic decision-making, multimodal code intelligence, long-context understanding, STEM reasoning, GUI comprehension
extraction_data.finetuning_data: Long chain-of-thought data, GUI-agent interaction data, ~1, 200, 000 samples (1/3 text-only, 2/3 image-text/video-text pairs); long-context technical documents, textbooks, videos up to 2 hours; multimodal function-calling trajectories
extraction_data.hardware_description: Hybrid parallelism (Tensor, Pipeline, Context, Expert, ZeRO-1 Data) on Megatron-LM framework, up to 10,000 GPUs.
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Pretraining (warm-up alignment -> full-parameter training with progressive context windows 8K/32K/256K) -> Post-training (SFT on long CoT -> knowledge distillation -> RL)
extraction_data.synthetic_data_generation_method: Systematic filtering, error correction, and synthetic augmentation, LLM-generated descriptions for entities; pseudo-labels from Qwen2.5-VL and OCR-specialized models; synthetic HTML/Markdown corpus; long-document parsing sequences by merging single-page samples; VQA generation for multi-page PDFs; automated object annotation synthesis using Qwen2.5-VL and GroundingDINO
extraction_data.rl_algorithm: Reinforcement Learning (Reasoning RL and General RL)
extraction_data.reward_mechanism: Hybrid: Rule-Based rewards for verifiable tasks/format adherence; Model-Based rewards using Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instructor as judge for open-ended tasks. Agentic RL uses Answer Accuracy, Multi-Turn Reasoning, and Tool-Calling rewards.
extraction_data.tool_calling_format: XML tags for function calls with JSON arguments; computer_use action format
extraction_data.fusion_architecture: DeepStack (cross-layer fusion via lightweight residual connections routing visual tokens from ViT to LLM layers)
extraction_data.vision_encoder: Multi-level ViT features, SigLIP-2 Large (300M), SigLIP-2 SO-400M, SigLIP-2, High-resolution, dynamic-resolution encoders
